title: Really Deep Down 3
author: bpatrick
body: Wednesday update! Yay for me. I’m trying for three updates this week. We’ll see what happens.

comments.author: Chris Downes
comments.text: Wow. Great comic. I know exactly where you’re coming from on this one.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: Thanks, Chris! It gets good (I hope) but comics take so long to make. I feel like I’ll never get there.

comments.author: cbobgo
comments.text: Is this the end? It’s been almost a year since you updated this one. It seems like a really good intro, I’m curious about the rest of the story.

comments.author: VanillaDice
comments.text: This one gets right to where it needs to, absolutely amazing. … Just like everything on here.
